Praesta, quaesumus, omnipotens Deus: ut dignitas condicionis humanae, per

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Domine Deus noster, qui in his potius creaturis, quas ad fragilitatis
nostrae subsidium condidisti, tuo quoque nomini munera jussisti dicanda
constitui: tribue, quaesumus; ut et vitae nobis praesentis auxilium, et
aeternitatis efficiant sacramentum. Per Dominum.

translations.caution:
A lay hand missal of the 1945 revision, printed about 1955-56, not an approved liturgical translation and never an altar book. Its Holy Week is the pre-1955 rite, its sanctoral is not the 1962 sanctoral, and its second and third orations are not those of 1962. It is carried only where a 1962 formulary is the same prayer, and nothing here may be used for recitation.

translations.text: O Lord, our God, Who hast especially commanded that these creatures, which Thou hast made for the support of our frailty, be also used as offerings to be dedicated to Thy name, grant, we beseech Thee, that they may provide for us both help for the present life and a sacrament for eternity. Through our Lord.
